name: io.github.tonyyang0504/line-social-mcp
description: LINE (social): me, publish_text, publish_image, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endp

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Channel access token of the LINE Official Account's Messaging API channel (long-lived token from the LINE Developers Console, or a v2.1 token), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer {channel access token}' (securitySchemes Bearer in https://github.com/line/line-openapi/blob/main/messaging-api.yml).
